Bill.BriefDescription: Promoting the works of August Wilson.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to promoting the works of August Wilson; adding newsections to chapter 43.46 RCW; and making an appropriation.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.46 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The Washington state arts commission shall work with interestedcitizens and groups to promote the works of Seattle playwright AugustWilson through activities such as performances, readings, workshops,lectures, and presentations for Washington educational institutions. (2) To accomplish the goals of this section, the Washington statearts commission shall make a reasonable effort to seek input andinvolvement from the following groups: (a) People with an intimate knowledge of August Wilson's life andworks; (b) Local theater groups; (c) Local humanities and cultural heritage groups; (d) Local colleges and universities; (e) The city of Seattle; and (f) King county.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.46 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In addition to the gifts and grants generally accepted underRCW 43.46.060, the arts commission may accept gifts, grants, andeconomic stimulus funds specifically for the purpose of accomplishingthe goals of section 1 of this act. (2) Promoting the works of August Wilson is deemed a proper use offunds obtained under RCW 43.46.060.

The sum of . . . . dollars, or as muchthereof as may be necessary, is appropriated for the fiscal year endingJune 30, 2010, from the general fund to the Washington state artscommission for the purposes of this act.
